newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks seen up on foreign buying.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks seen up on foreign buying.

text.p: Thai stocks were expected to continue rising slightly on Tuesday as foreign investors were expected to buy discounted stocks, especially in banking, brokers said.

"The market is expected to be sluggish today ahead of the coming holiday (for Water Festival) while investors at the same time are waiting for first quarter corporate earnings," said Padermpob Songkroh of Nava Finance and Securities.
The composite SET index closed 8.08 points higher to 714.09 on 3.4 billion baht turnover on Friday. The market was closed on Monday for a public holiday.
Brokers said the prospect of poor first quarter earnings results and an upcoming long weekend holidays from April 14-15 would keep local investors from entering the market.
The market will be closed on Monday and Tuesday for the holidays.
